changes_made.explanation: Normalized model names to include version numbers where specified, merged duplicate task descriptions, added the fifth dataset (drugs.com) mentioned in the paper for completeness. Removed 'Other:Text Generation' as it's redundant with the synthetic text generation focus.
The extracted metrics are correct and complete. All three metrics (Accuracy, Macro F1-score, Perplexity) are consistently used throughout the experiments to evaluate synthetic text quality.

Removed BLOOM-560m and perplexity calculation from this section. BLOOM-560m is used only for perplexity calculation, which is an automatic metric, not an LLM-as-judge evaluation. The paper does not use post-generation LLM evaluation.
No human evaluation is conducted in this paper. The evaluation is entirely automated using classification metrics and perplexity.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on synthetic text generation under differential privacy constraints. The metadata extraction was generally accurate. Main changes involved normalizing model versions (BART-large, BLOOM-560m, Phi-1.5) and clarifying that perplexity calculation using BLOOM is an automatic metric, not LLM-as-judge evaluation. The paper uses only automatic evaluation methods without human or LLM-as-judge assessments.
